explanation: The requested point is physically allowed. EXCLURAD was run with the standard eta CLAS12 settings (model 3, full O(alpha) corrections, 6.53 GeV beam momentum, electron beam, detected recoil proton, and vcut = 0.166 GeV^2). EXCLURAD wrote sigma_Born as 0.0008651649 in radtot.dat, but wrote NaN for sigma_obs/sigma_Born (delta), following NaN values from its full radiative integration; delta is therefore recorded as null rather than as a valid number.
